local_authoring_parts::6db6e68012a7e61d9.identity: 빈 섬에서 주민과 시설의 생활 연결망을 직접 만들어 가는 작은 공동체 성장 게임으로 재설계한다. 플레이어는 무인도 마을에서 Gather a focused set of island resources.을 중심으로 선택 결과가 다음 월드 상태를 바꾸는 CASUAL 게임이다. 대표 선택과 세계 규칙이 결합되어 같은 장르의 단순 반복과 다른 경로·위험·결과를 만든다. 성장할수록 새 행동 조합·경로·관계·발견·대응법 중 장르에 맞는 가능성이 실제 플레이에 열린다.

coreLoop: Gather a focused set of island resources. -> Use them to build or improve one village function.
Unlock a new resident, activity or area and choose the next village goal.
Repeat the process to grow the village and unlock new possibilities.

local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.name: ISLAND_RESOURCE_MANAGER
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.purpose: Manage and allocate island resources to build or improve village functions
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.playerChoice: Select which resource to gather and how to use it for village development

local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_PLAN_MANAGER
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.purpose: Manage the progression of resources to village functions and track growth milestones.
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.playerChoice: Select which resource to gather, which function to build/improve, and what next goal to unlock.

local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_STRATEGY_ENGINE
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.purpose: Manage the strategic progression of village development and resource allocation.
local_authoring_parts::8eb8d0425c433e205.playerChoice: Select a new resident, activity, or area to unlock and determine the next goal based on current resources and goals.
